name: loop-qa
title: Loop QA
description: An agentic QA workspace after Loop QA / Replay QA. Projects (a URL under test) with drawn site thumbnails, bug trends and live-run state; per project an Overview (tiles, the live run, an exploration replay carousel, latest findings), a filterable Bugs table (severity, status, kind, environment; copy, download and connect an issue tracker), a Site map tree with coverage, Test runs and generated Playwright tests with highlighted source. A bug opens to its session replay (ReplayPreview: scrubber markers for the failed request and the error, a drawn cursor with click ripples), network and console logs that seek the replay, expected vs actual, a chronology whose evidence frames are the replay frozen at each step, and the root cause; a run to its findings, coverage, exploration and journeys. The Ask QA agent is an ArtifactChatContainer around the app (the page is the artifact): a trailing column on a desktop, a floating composer over the page on a tablet or phone with the transcript on its draggable bump (the newest reply peeking on a tablet), folded into a FAB when hidden; tool calls in a work log, streamed Markdown answers, and runs that report live in a card. ⌘K jumps to any project, bug or run and runs commands (start a run, copy reports, change a bug's status or severity, connect a tracker, switch the theme) across nested pages with a bug preview pane. One SplitView at every size — tiled on a desktop, a floating sidebar on a tablet, a stack on a phone; light and dark.
